description: Max Translation Depth 0. Function Nested(): the entry runs a collapsed graph GoldenCollapsed (In -> CollectGarbage -> Out), whose Out runs the Blueprint's own macro LocalSteps (In -> ControlScreensaver -> Out).

known_defects.effect: Collapsed graphs and the Blueprint's own macros only count as nested graphs within the depth limit: at depth 0 (the default) GoldenCollapsed and LocalSteps are not captured and only the opaque Composite and MacroInstance nodes remain
The Composite and MacroInstance nodes do not name the graph captured for them (the Composite has no member_parent or member_name)
Execution flows are 'N1->N2' node pairs: which exec output and which exec input a link uses is lost, and two outputs into one node collapse to one entry
Node and pin names are display text (menu titles, friendly pin names, blank exec pin names), not stable identifiers, so they change with editor language and settings
